## Analysis

sol_0042 found no improvement despite broad widths, core lengths, independent fringe masks, crossover, and correlated mutations. Combined with sol_0035–0041, this strongly suggests the entire single-interval-core/two-fringe family is capped near 1.094607, rather than merely locally trapped. Repeated-copy constructions, direct coordinate edits, and fringe-only optimization are likewise exhausted. The next search should remove the interval-core assumption and optimize unrestricted multi-cluster geometry with large coordinated moves.
